name: 5399-synth256-7b-8gpu
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, single-node multiprocessing executor (one worker process per rank, no Ray). Declared only at TP=8.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 32 layers, 32 query / 32 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, window 4096, fp16, unquantized -- ~13.5 GiB of weights, ~1.7 GiB per rank at TP=8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=320, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 8000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, request_format: plain -- the prompt goes to the engine as a raw completion string, no chat template. Fixed by construction: every request is exactly 256 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min=max on both), no prefix buckets, no length distribution, no shared prefix. Sampling is temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, and the backend forces ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter text completion service handling 320 concurrent uniform 256-token prompts and replies across eight GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.1-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- most of a modern config does not exist here.
# READ LINE BY LINE: `key: value` only, a value beginning `{` or `[` taken as JSON;
# an indented YAML block silently never reaches AsyncEngineArgs.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf

tensor-parallel-size: 8

pipeline-parallel-size: 1

distributed-executor-backend: mp

max-model-len: 4096

max-num-batched-tokens: 4096

max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

dtype: float16

enforce-eager: false

seed: 0
